algorithm: Validate source metadata and worker-stack contract before allocation. Build the same9216-entry inverse dictionary after the main root/challenges.

Acquire one existing WorkPool lease. Each bounded contiguous logical chunk computes relative prefixes into disjoint positions of the private FINAL output buffer using the same extracted per-row tuple/inverse/event recipe as serial.
Join the entire prefix wave and inspect errors. Scan chunk totals in stable logical order to obtain offsets and final claim.
A second joined wave owns disjoint secure-column groups. A256-physical-row stack tile derives inverse placement and logical chunk IDs once, then adds the corresponding four offset limbs column-wise.
Publish interaction only after both waves and all error checks succeed. Every error drains helpers, releases the lease, frees private output, and leaves trace.interaction empty for retry.
